title: Compatible augmented representatives for the strict open tensor map
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a quasi-compact open immersion j:U→V of schemes on which l is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the completed integral coefficients [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], the module categories and ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Site and coefficient universes are independent. There are compatible reduction/total-limit calculi with their coherence, exact localized open operations, the ordinary scalar reductions, and strict open comparisons, collected in CompletedOpenTensor.Context, with reduction/total-limit calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], open operations [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison], and strict semilinear data [def-sf-open-semilinear-tensor-model-data]. The integral closed structures equal those of IntegralOnSlice.duality [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Completion and restriction-completion comparisons satisfy the actual-unit equations [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector, lem-sf-immersion-completed-pullback-comparison], the ordinary open unit is its adjunction unit, and the strict all-input reduction comparison restricts to the complete-object comparison. There is a natural isomorphism gamma from j_!K tensor N to j_!(K tensor j^*N), computed on all flat-term K-flat representatives by the summand-normalized total-complex chain map [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. For every such pair P,Q, restriction and both total tensors are K-flat, and there are simultaneous reduction Computations aV,aU satisfying the ordinary localization square, the scalar-unit augmentation equation in every degree and coefficient level on every local section, and the whole-system localization square of RepresentativeLaws. This is the construction before completed realization; it asserts no completed comparison, uniqueness, or total-limit realization identity.

proof.text: Choose compatible models C using lem-pur-completed-open-tensor-context and gamma with its ordinary localization square using the proved lem-pur-open-tensor-ordinary-descent. The proved open restriction good-complex theorem gives flat-term K-flat restriction. Extension preserves flat terms and K-flatness by C.strictOpen; kFlat_total_tensor_model makes both total tensors good representatives.

proof.text: Apply ordinaryReductionAugmentedComputation to both coefficient calculi and their OrdinaryReduction functors. The resulting representative isomorphisms are natural on the good-complex categories. Two Computations with the same complex and ordinary evaluation are equal on their iso.hom: their AugmentedPresentation chain maps agree on every degree, coefficient level and local section, and the adjunction homEquiv is injective. Thus the computations in the strict open model square can be replaced by these natural computations.
